newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech crown pushes to new highs against mark.
newsitem.headline: Czech crown pushes to new highs against mark.

text.p: The Czech crown strengthened sharply in early trading on Friday, breaking through the 17 crown barrier against the mark and at times edging over five percent above the mid-point of its mark/dollar basket.
At 0804 GMT the crown was trading at 27.315 to the dollar and 16.999 to the mark, putting it 4.99 percent above the mid-point of the basket compared with 4.5 percent at the open.
The crown's recent rally has been driven by a wave of crown Eurobonds since the beginning of the year.
Dealers said they did not think that the central bank would be content to let the crown stay below 17 to the mark for long but were unsure how it would react in the short term.
"People are not very sure about the central bank because we've never seen central bank intervention against a strong crown," said Petr Tomek of Zivnostneska Banka.
Tomek said that as a result of the uncertainty, trading was thin and spreads were wide.
